environment.host: test server: 4 cores of an AMD Ryzen 9 5950X, 10 GiB RAM, Linux container (Ubuntu 26.04); other test instances on it stay mostly idle during runs
environment.bots: tools/loadbot on a separate machine in the same LAN (offline mode, no encryption)
environment.settings: seed -578941029922802438, normal world, peaceful, view distance 10, simulation distance 10, offline mode, pause-when-empty off, a new world per scenario

servers.vanillite: Vanillite dev 26.3, release-fast build, rule profile vanilla (paper profile as extra rows); memory limit 6 GiB
servers.paper: Paper 26.3 build 262, default configuration (Paper's own optimisations on), Java 25, -Xms1G -Xmx6G
servers.pumpkin: Pumpkin 0.2.2+26.3-26.60 release binary, defaults (no tick time report, so no MSPT)
servers.vanillite-proxy: vanillite-proxy from the same commit, modern forwarding

environment.mspt: Vanillite: every tick (tick log). Paper and Vanilla: `/tick query` every 5 s (P50/P95/P99/mean of the last 100 ticks), averaged over the window; max is the highest P99 window.

startup.title: Startup time and idle memory
startup.what: Start with a new world until the server answers a status ping (cold), restart with that world (warm), then RSS and CPU of the empty, ticking server over 30 s.

redstone.title: Redstone: clocks, dust lines and pistons
redstone.what: 93 observer clocks, each driving a 15-block redstone dust line into a sticky piston that moves a block (1 395 dust, 93 pistons), on a platform at y 280.
